replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Not at all. With my background, math feels like an old friend. My high conscientiousness means I approach it methodically, and my low neuroticism ensures I don't feel anxious. It's a tool that has served me well, so I see no reason to fear it.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I haven't used AI for math learning, as my upper secondary education sufficed for my needs. But I appreciate that younger generations might find it helpful. My own children, now adults, have used such tools, and they found them useful.
